title: Representation by Design in Generation: Cross-View Class-Token Alignment in Diffusion Transformers
abstract: Generative and representation learning remain asymmetrically connected: semantic representations are used to improve diffusion generation, whereas the models' own representations are often treated as a by-product of synthesis. We ask whether diffusion models can instead be trained to learn substantially stronger semantic representations without sacrificing generation quality. SelfFlow takes a step in this direction by introducing self-supervised patch alignment into flow matching, but its main gains remain in faster convergence and improved generation. Inspired by DINO and iBOT, we extend this framework with cross-view class-token alignment to further strengthen semantic representations. Specifically, we form two independently noised, dual-timestep observations of each image and align each student class-token representation with the stop-gradient EMA-teacher target from the other observation. This objective is optimized jointly with the inherited flow-matching and local patch objectives. Notably, although the additional objective acts only on the class token, it strengthens both class-token and patch representations. Compared with a matched two-view baseline, ImageNet linear-probing accuracy improves by 9.4\% using the class token and 10.1\% using mean-pooled patch tokens, while frozen-backbone VOC2012 segmentation improves by 3.6 mIoU. These representation gains are achieved while maintaining comparable ImageNet generation FID. In text-to-image training, the same objective also improves generation FID, reducing it from 2.52 to 2.37 at matched checkpoints. Our results show that representation need not remain a by-product of generation or merely a tool for improving it: it can be directly optimized as a first-class capability of diffusion pretraining alongside generation.

analysis.ideaZh: 在 two-view SelfFlow 的 flow+patch alignment 上，加 cross-view CLS 对 EMA teacher cosine 目标，作者报告 CLS linear63.49→72.90、patch60.03→70.11、VOC57.15→60.79，ImageNetFID5.12→5.26 略差。生成 backbone 学更强 perception features 值得速读；两 noise views 不是 multi-camera，teacher 仍 class-conditioned，probe 大量 validation 调参、单 pretraining run，T2IFID2.517→2.369 仅同 evaluator 可比。
analysis.motivationZh: diffusion 生成训练不一定形成可用于理解的稳定语义表征。目标是在生成过程中学习跨噪声、跨视图一致的 global representation，并保留空间信息。
analysis.methodZh: 两个独立 Gaussian/maskbranch 共享 cleanlatent 与 timestep pair，studentpatches 混 clean/noisytime，EMA teacher 更 clean。两 variants 都有 CLS、two-viewflow 和 sameviewpatchcosine；新 variant 仅对 studentCLS 与 oppositebranchrawteacherCLS 加 cosineloss，学 noise-invariantglobalsemanticrepresentations，并通过 sharedtransformer 改善 patchlinear/denseprobe。主价值是把 diffusion 的 representation 作为可优化能力而非只服务 FID，结果不是新 MLLM 或结构化 designmodel。
methodFlow: 以 frozenSDVAE 把 image 变 16×16latentpatchgrid，对同 image 采两 independentnoise/masks 及共用 clean/noisytimepair
student 用 mixedtimestepinputs，EMA teacher 用同 branch uniformlycleanerinputs，二者都保 CLS
既有 flowvelocityloss 与 sameviewpatch alignment 不变，新增 studentCLS 经 MLP 对 oppositeviewrawteacherCLS 的 negativecosine
AdamW 联合训练、EMA teacherstopgradient 更新，discardalignmentheads 用于 generation/frozenprobes
nullclass+t.8features 作 CLS/meanpatchlinearprobe 与 VOC 线性 densehead，另用同 samplingFID 比较生成

analysis.insightZh: 在 matchedtwo-viewgenerativepretraining 中显式优化 globalsemanticobjective，连 patch/densefeatures 大幅改善，是生成与 discriminativecapability 协同的有用 representation advance。DINO/iBOT/selfdistill/双 time 继承已有原则，新增一个 CLSobjective 并非首次 jointgenerativerepresentation 学习；crossview 是 noiseview 不是真实 3Dmultiview。

analysis.caveatZh:
单 pretrainingrun/config，seedvariability 和更大 scale 尚未评估。
主要 ImageNet/VOCtransfer，T2Irepresentation 未 probe、其他 tasks 需扩展。
T2Icompositional 结果 mixed，depth/attention 描述不能确证 patchgain 机制。
ImageNetteacher 保 classlabels、student10%dropout，nullconditionprobe 不等于 pretraining 无 labels，别写全自监督 datafree。
crossview 仅 noise/mask 变换，不能联想成 multi-camera3Dconsistency。
33LR×60epoch 及 readoutdepth 用 validation 挑最高，gain 需独立 test/seed 确认；VOC 每 validation freshnoise 再 valmax 有额外 selectionvariance。
FID1M 稍退化而 earlyweighttradeoff 明显，不能称无任何 generationcost。
T2I 用 torchvisionInception 和自建 50kref，不对标外部 standardFID；sourceIDs/prompts 无重复并未排除 imagecontentduplicate。
